description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Malphite''' gains [[File:Armor icon.svg|15px|link=Armor]] '''bonus''' armor, tripled while ''[[File:Malphite Granite Shield.png|20xpx|border|link=Malphite#Granite Shield|An icon for Malphite's ability Granite Shield]] [[Malphite#Granite Shield|Granite Shield]]'' is active.
description.text: Passive: Malphite gains  bonus armor, tripled while Granite Shield is active.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Malphite''' empowers his next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 50 '''bonus''' range, and deal [[File:Successfully enhanced damage physical icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] '''additional''' physical damage [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]].
description2.text: Active: Malphite empowers his next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain  50 bonus range, and deal additional physical damage on-hit.

description3.raw: Additionally, '''Malphite's''' basic attacks [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] for the next 5 seconds are empowered to trigger a cone in the direction of the target that deals physical damage to enemies hit.
description3.text: Additionally, Malphite's basic attacks on-hit for the next 5 seconds are empowered to trigger a cone in the direction of the target that deals physical damage to enemies hit.

description4.raw: ''Thunderclap'' deals 180% damage against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].

description5.raw: ''Thunderclap [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Malphite's''' basic attack timer.''
description5.text: Thunderclap resets Malphite's basic attack timer.

notes.text:
The main target is dealt basic damage, though without applying life steal, while the cone deals area non- proc damage without applying spell effects.
* The cone will trigger Jax's Counter Strike damage reduction, Cheap Shot, Conqueror, Dark Harvest, Electrocute, Summon Aery, Eclipse, World Atlas enemy champion proc, and Ocean Dragon Soul.
** It is also special cased to trigger Tear of the Goddess.
* The cone does not benefit from Spear of Shojin's damage amp.
The passive will amplify negative armor, too, if Malphite's armor is dropped that low.
The passive's bonus armor stacks with an instance of recursion.
The empowered attack:
* Benefits from Thunderclap's cone effect.
* Prevents Malphite from casting Seismic Shard and Ground Slam during its windup.
* Cannot have its windup canceled by new movement or attack commands, or casting Unstoppable Force.
* Can have its windup canceled by casting Hextech Rocketbelt.
The cone starts from Malphite's location.
* Unlike similar spells, it does not deal its damage separately to the primary target of the attack(s); if the target is outside the area of effect when struck, it will not take the additional damage.
